review:
15 Coins Grand Diamond Edition is another Diamond Edition Wazdan slot with a 5,000x Grand, this time on 15 reels. The Coins basics are all here: Cash Infinity for bigger prizes and easier bonus entry, Chance Level to multiply your bet, and Hold the Jackpot as the main event.

What sets it apart is how Cash Out is spelled out. A label sticks to a reel for up to 20 spins, collects the values of Bonus symbols that land there, and pays a percentage of them, with multipliers of up to 300%. That gives the base game a slow-building side quest while you wait for the bonus. High volatility, 96.15% RTP. Try the 15 Coins Grand Diamond Edition demo free before playing for real.
